question: Who among the following Peshwas signed the Treaty of Bassein with the British East India Company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baji Rao II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Baji Rao II:-**

 
 
• He was the Peshwa who signed the Treaty of Bassein with the British East India Company in 1802.
 
• Baji Rao II was the last Peshwa of the Maratha Empire, and his signing of the treaty led to the downfall of the empire.
